t: This is Holy Trinity Church, a Church of England parish church in Rotherhithe, in the diocese of Southwark. It was designed by Thomas Ford, who served as Diocesan Architect for Southwark and won the Ashpitel Prize from the Royal Institute of British Architects. He was a prolific church architect, so this is one of many buildings of its kind from his hand. Ford also worked with his brother Ralph to translate the New Testament in 1948.
